_readme: X3D CCD Affinity Guard configuration. The daemon hot-reloads this file within ~2 seconds of saving.
_hardware: CCD0 mask 0xFFFF = logical CPU 0-15, owns the 96 MB stacked 3D V-Cache. CCD1 mask 0xFFFF0000 = CPU 16-31, 32 MB L3 but higher clocks. Verify your own layout with: pwsh -File .\X3D-CCDAffinity.ps1 -Status

groups.name: ccd0-cache
groups.comment: Games that benefit from the 96 MB L3. Add exe file names (case-insensitive, must include .exe). priority: null | AboveNormal | High | RealTime

groups.name: ccd1-freq
groups.comment: Optional: titles that prefer raw clock speed over cache (competitive shooters, emulators). Usually left empty.
